delete_leg: strongest divergence magnitude; ties match_idx then match_id
ledger_scope: every frozen policy x canonical issue x each of four arms
outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: target score/result/final-or-winning SP/payout/tax/ROI/settlement fields are forbidden; historical scores enter the accepted #180 state only under its frozen kickoff <= issue cutoff - 180 minute embargo

per_leg_probability_sources.MODEL_AGREEMENT: per match, weaker agreeing source; exact tie fundamental first; never blended

rule: enumerate the 1458 tickets excluding the most-negative-delta code at the strongest eligible leg; repeat the 729 highest joint-estimator-probability tickets once; ties by base-3 ordinal
ticket_ordinal: base-3 code order 3,1,0; ascending ordinal is the deterministic tie break
